note: Gameplay objects as points and types, game uu (100 uu = 1 m); no surfaces. drops: the roadmap's one-way drops (from/to are roadmap nodes of <map>.nav.json; fallMeters = height lost). traversals: one per roadmap link, in the roadmap's link order (from/to are the roadmap nodes the link joins; ropes also name bottom/top and whether from->to ascends; soundSource / soundSourceExit are the points its sound is emitted from at the entry and the exit, soundRadiusUu is null and soundVerified false until a value is measured). doors / breakables: position on the floor in the opening, zones = the zone of the nearest roadmap point on each side of the opening (one zone for a prop; gates, where present, is the zone-graph edge the door is attached to), defaultState open/closed/intact/unknown. notLocated: mechanics known for the map that no scene object or floor measurement could place. ultOrbs: orb positions, empty where the scene has no orb object. Every entry states its own provenance.
provenance: measured-on-mesh (positions: scene object bounding boxes and walk-grid cells; drops and the zones: the navigation roadmap); manual-approx (travel times and speeds, default states, and the reading of which scene object is which gameplay object)

ultOrbs.provenance: manual-approx (game knowledge: which callout holds the orb; NOT measured — orbs are spawned actors absent from the static scene, and the two public wikis refused automated reads on 2026-11-24). position = the zone's roadmap anchor, not the orb's exact spot
